title.en: How the Body Keeps Things Steady

desc.zh: 进和出一直在变，身体却把血糖、体温、药量守在很窄的范围里。九个可以拖动的模型：半衰期与平台、酒精、血糖反馈、发烧、治疗窗、心脏、抗生素和群体免疫。
desc.en: Inputs and outputs never stop changing, yet the body keeps glucose, temperature and drug levels in narrow ranges. Nine models you can push: half-life and plateau, alcohol, glucose feedback, fever, the therapeutic window, the heart, antibiotics and herd immunity.

title.en: Inflow, outflow and the set point

desc.zh: 流出量跟存量成正比时，存量会自己停在“进水 ÷ 漏的比例”处，被推开后差距按固定时间减半。
desc.en: When outflow is proportional to the stock, the stock settles at inflow ÷ leak rate and any push decays by half in a fixed time.

zh: 为什么身体能保持平衡
en: why does the body stay balanced

desc.zh: 按时服药，体内药量约五个半衰期后到平台；漏服与补双倍各有什么后果。
desc.en: Regular doses climb to a plateau in about five half-lives; what a missed dose or a double dose does.

zh: 为什么每8小时吃一次药
药为什么要吃几天才见效
en: why does medicine take days to work

desc.zh: 分解酒精的酶很快饱和，每小时只能清除差不多固定的量，所以下降是直线、喝得太快就没有平台。
desc.en: The enzyme that breaks down alcohol saturates early, so a roughly fixed amount leaves per hour: a straight-line fall and no plateau if you drink faster.

zh: 为什么酒精是直线下降
en: how fast alcohol leaves the body

desc.zh: 胰岛素和胰高血糖素把血糖往回推；反应太弱会偏高很久，太晚又太猛会跌过头。
desc.en: Insulin and glucagon push glucose back; a weak response leaves it high, a late and strong one overshoots into a dip.

zh: 糖尿病血糖为什么降不下来

title.en: Fever as a raised set point

desc.zh: 致热原把体温设定点拨高，所以发烧时发冷、退烧时出汗；中暑的高热则是散热到了上限。
desc.en: Pyrogens raise the temperature set point, so a fever starts with chills and breaks with sweating; heat stroke is cooling at its limit instead.

en: why do you feel cold with a fever

desc.zh: 有效浓度和有害浓度之间的距离；同样的总量分几次吃、清除变慢，会让体内的量落在窗里还是窗外。
desc.en: The gap between an effective and a harmful level; how splitting the same daily dose, or slower clearance, keeps the level inside or outside it.

zh: 为什么肾功能差要减量
en: why reduce dose for kidney impairment

title.zh: 心输出量 = 心率 × 每搏量
title.en: Cardiac output = heart rate × stroke volume

desc.zh: 运动时身体守住的是供氧，心率和每搏量被调动；锻炼降低静息心率，年龄压低心率上限。
desc.en: During exercise the body holds oxygen delivery and moves heart rate and stroke volume; training lowers resting heart rate, age lowers the maximum.

zh: 运动时心跳为什么加快
en: why athletes have low heart rates
why heart rate rises in exercise

desc.zh: 浓度落在敏感菌和耐药菌的 MIC 之间时，药会替耐药菌清出地方；提前停药是否偏向耐药，取决于剂量。
desc.en: Concentrations between the sensitive and resistant MICs clear the way for resistant bacteria; whether stopping early favours resistance depends on the dose.

en: do you need to finish antibiotics

desc.zh: 免疫比例超过 1 − 1/R₀ 时，每个病例平均传给不到一个人，疫情自己熄灭。
desc.en: Once the immune share exceeds 1 − 1/R₀, each case infects fewer than one other on average and the outbreak dies out.

en: how many people need to be vaccinated
